clinical_intent: I am evaluating PET-CT for brachytherapy planning in cervical cancer. FDG-PET can visualize the primary tumor and lymph nodes. How should I integrate PET findings into brachytherapy target volume delineation? What are the limitations of PET for brachytherapy planning? How does PET-CT compare with MRI for target delineation? Should I use PET-CT routinely for brachytherapy planning?
